import base64, os, re

files = {
    r"C:\IA-DEV\sentiment-app\docs\cadrage\cas1-pharmacie.md":
"",
    r"C:\IA-DEV\sentiment-app\docs\cadrage\cas2-reglement.md":
"",
    r"C:\IA-DEV\sentiment-app\docs\cadrage\cas3-avisnegatifs.md":
"",
}

for path, b64 in files.items():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(base64.b64decode(b64))
    txt = open(path, encoding="cp1252").read()
    checked = len(re.findall(r"- \[x\]", txt))
    m = re.search(r"## Justification\n(.*?)(\n##|\Z)", txt, re.DOTALL)
    crit = re.findall(r"\([a-d]\)", m.group(1)) if m else []
    headers = [l.strip() for l in txt.splitlines() if l.startswith("## ")]
    print(os.path.basename(path))
    print("  cases cochees =", checked, "| criteres justification =", crit)
    print("  rubriques trouvees =", headers)
    print()

print("OK, fichiers ecrits. Lance maintenant:")
print("  python -m pytest tests/test_cadrage.py -q")
